reason: A DSH settings-panel plugin that organizes installed plugins and provides controls for inspecting, enabling, disabling, registering, and uninstalling user extensions, including persistence and runtime hot loading.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 设置页集中展示、分类、搜索并管理插件，支持启用、停用、登记、卸载和热加载用户扩展。
summaries.en: A DSH settings-panel plugin for organizing, searching, enabling, disabling, registering, uninstalling, and hot-loading user extensions.

capabilities: Displays and categorizes installed plugins in a settings panel
Enables, disables, registers, and uninstalls user plugins
Modifies package.json, cordis.patch.yml, dependency directories, and persisted descriptions
Applies plugin changes through runtime hot loading
